message.subject: Base-Rent Commencement date

body.content:
Hi Alex,

  

Thank you again for completing the exterior stair work and helping us obtain
the final Certificate of Occupancy on November 3.

  

I am asking you to reconsider our earlier request and extend the current Base
Rent abatement for aleast three additional months, covering December 1, 2026
through February 28, 2027, with Base Rent commencing April 1, 2027. We would
continue paying NNN, utilities and other applicable Additional Rent during
this period.

  

The fire alarm work took approximately 142 days - April-to-August. During
substantial portions of this period, critical-path tenant work—including
closure of the affected ceilings and progress toward final inspections—was
materially delayed.

  

We have made a substantial investment in the premises and incurred significant
carrying costs while being unable to operate. A three to four month extension
would help the new business stabilize after these construction and compliance
delays while preserving the long-term landlord-tenant relationship.

  

Please reconsider allowing Base Rent to commence on April 1, 2027. We would
document the revised commencement date in a short written lease amendment
before December 1.

  

Thank you for considering this request. I would be happy to discuss it with
you directly.

  

Best regards,

Bharath

Smash District, LLC
